description: Closing relentlessly down the stretch, American History catches favorites Coach Pope and Q B Rocket to win the Oct. 3 Breeders' Futurity (G1) at Keeneland.

description: Team Valor International's U. S. S. Valor sailed to a dominant 6 1/2-length victory in the $500,000 Champagne Stakes (G1) Oct. 3 at Belmont Park, but connections are hesitant to commit to a trip to the Breeders' Cup Juvenile (G1).

title_en: Ace Stud Lands Arc Entrant Bright Light to Top Arc Sale
description: Ace Stud comes to the fore at the Arqana Arc Sale Oct. 3 when swooping for the two top lots, Bright Light, an entrant in the Oct. 4 Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe (G1), and Space Waltz, each for seven figures.

title_en: Evanescence, Joe Shiesty Capture Grade 2s at Keeneland
description: Evanescence earns an automatic berth in the Breeders' Cup Filly and Mare Sprint (G1) by rallying to take the Oct. 3 Thoroughbred Club of America Stakes (G2) at Keeneland by a neck over Praying.

title_en: Unbeaten Vanta Gets Graded Test in Surfer Girl Stakes
description: In two starts, both wins, 2-year-old filly Vanta has shown signs of a budding star for trainer Jeff Mullins. In the Oct. 4 Surfer Girl Stakes (G3T), Vanta will look to add a second stakes win and a first at the graded level.

title_en: Caballo de Mar Upsets Scandinavia to Repeat in Cadran
description: Caballo de Mar edges away from favored Scandinavia to become the first horse since Westerner in 2004 to secure successive Prix du Cadran (G1) victories Oct. 3 at ParisLongchamp Racecourse.

title_en: Piggybunz Gives Happy Saver His First Stakes Winner
description: Grade 1 winner and first-crop Airdrie Stud stallion Happy Saver was represented by his first black-type winner Oct. 3 when Piggybunz won the $96,000 Smart Halo Stakes at Laurel Park.

title_en: Mystik Dan's Half Brother Mystik Bayou Wins at Belmont
description: Wells Bayou, whose stallion career ended early because of fertility problems, has just one foal: the 2-year-old Mystik Bayou. But acting solo, the juvenile is doing his part to keep his sire in the headlines.

title_en: Five Group 1s, BC Berths Featured on Arc Undercard
description: While the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe (G1) is the main event Oct. 4 at ParisLongchamp Racecourse, there are five other group 1 races on the card, all Breeders' Cup Challenge Series: Win and You're In events.

title_en: Ortiz Jr. Grateful to be Back in Saddle
description: Irad Ortiz Jr. returned to the saddle Oct. 2 at Keeneland and picked up a win in the Phoenix Stakes (G2) after missing nearly two months with a foot injury.

title_en: Blue Bolt Continues Perfect Season With Sun Chariot Win
description: The daughter of Blue Point looked none the worse for a busy season that had yielded five successive wins, three at this level, in the paddock beforehand and even earned the best turned out prize before trouncing Evolutionist and City of Memphis.

title_en: Two-Time Champion Sprinter Roy H Dies at 14
description: Two-time champion male sprinter Roy H died Oct. 2 following complications from colic at 14. Roy H had been a resident of the Kentucky Horse Park's Hall of Champions barn since November 2023.

title_en: Spinster a Path to Breeders' Cup, Eclipse Honors
description: West Point Thoroughbreds' Counting Stars is already favored to earn the Eclipse Award as outstanding 3-year-old filly, and now she faces older rivals for the first time in the Oct. 4 Spinster Stakes (G1) at Keeneland.

title_en: As Youth Steps Up, the Old Boys Deserve a Last Hurrah
description: In this week's On Racing, the emphasis on youth at this time each year is relentless. But let the congregation pause for a moment to give thanks for those tireless campaigners who have taken their people on long and glorious rides.

title_en: No Illusion as Serenas Ghost Upsets Jessamine Stakes
description: On Oct. 2, just three weeks after her winning debut at Horseshoe Indianapolis, Serenas Ghost registers a clear victory in the $388,250 Jessamine Stakes (G2T) at Keeneland.

title_en: British Tax Increase Threatens Jobs, Betting Income
description: The British Horseracing Authority is "strongly urging" government to consider the impact on horse racing of a potential rise in machine games duty to 40% after a betting industry analyst warned almost three-quarters of betting shops would be closed.

title_en: Skippylongstocking to Stand at New York's Amsterdam Two
description: Skippylongstocking, a 12-time graded stakes winner by Exaggerator, has an initial fee of $3,500, which could change following his performance in the Oct. 31 Breeders' Cup Classic (G1) at Keeneland, according to Amsterdam Two Farm.

title_en: Emphatic Repels Summer Starlet to Win Alcibiades
description: Emphatic was not to be denied in the Alcibiades Stakes (G1) Oct. 2 at Keeneland, as she sprinted early from the rail, held the lead throughout, and inched away from a closing Summer Starlet to remain undefeated in three races.
